simulate_posterior_predictive: generate posterior predictive samples from a generative model using posterior MonteCarloSamples and queried random variables
simulate_prior_predictive: generate prior predictive samples from a generative model by specifying queries and a number of samples
simulate_vectorized_predictive: generate vectorized posterior predictive samples in a single forward pass using the vectorized sampler option
empirical_sample_distribution: sample from the empirical marginal distribution of queried variables using MonteCarloSamples with replacement
concat_rv_dicts: concatenate a list of random variable dictionaries along the last dimension and squeeze the batch dimension
